settings.headline: Accessibility statement
settings.subtitle: The City of Juniper Falls wants everyone to be able to use this website, including people who use screen readers, keyboards, magnification or captions.

settings.headline: Our commitment
settings.body:
We design and test this website against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, level AA. That is the standard the U.S. Department of Justice adopted in 2024 for state and local government websites under Title II of the Americans with Disabilities Act. For a city of our size (more than 50,000 residents), the compliance date is April 26, 2027, after the Department's April 2026 extension.

What we do

  • Every page has a skip link, landmarks, a logical heading order and a visible keyboard focus.
  • Text and buttons meet WCAG contrast ratios. Pages work when zoomed to 200 percent and on small screens.
  • Images have text alternatives, or are marked as decorative.
  • Forms and filters have visible labels.
  • New agendas and notices are published as tagged PDFs, and meeting videos are captioned.

What we are still working on

  • Some older documents in the meeting archive, from before 2022, are scanned images. Ask us and we will provide an accessible copy within five working days.
  • Some linked third-party systems, such as the payment portal, are run by vendors. We ask each vendor for a conformance report and track their fixes.

An independent audit of the whole site is out for proposals now. See the request for proposals.
settings.side:
If something on this site does not work for you, tell us and we will fix it or give you the information another way.
